description.hi: श्रीहनुमत् त्रिकाल स्मरणम् — तीन काल के तीन श्लोक (गीताप्रेस कल्याण हनुमान-अंक परंपरा)।
description.en: Three Sanskrit shlokas for morning, noon, and evening remembrance of Hanuman (Gita Press Kalyan Hanuman anka tradition).

edition.notes: Corrected 2026-07-23: previous pack was Sanskrit collage under wrong Maruti Stotra title. Replaced with authentic Hanumat Trikala Smaranam (3 shlokas). Note: Samarth Ramdas Marathi Maruti Stotra is a separate work.
